svg.title: All 36 forwards, separate packet span, packet sum, and host elapsed panels
svg.text: Shaded generations 1-5: prompt. Generations 6-36: decode after the first generated token.
Packet interval span; displayed axis 117-123 ms (not zero-based)
Sum of packet intervals; displayed axis 117-123 ms (not zero-based)
Separate host batch elapsed (not GPU time); displayed axis 129-145 ms (not zero-based)
Separate panels retain all 108 observations. Span and sum nearly coincide; neither is a GPU utilization measure.
Host Instant durations have no absolute alignment to these GPU-correlated system timestamps.
